transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this enforcement-review meeting regarding Northstar Systems. As you know, their quarterly royalty reports have been showing inconsistent usage figures, and the commercial team wants this handled without disrupting the existing license. Before I can approve any enforcement plan or authorize a formal notice to Northstar, I need input from each of you per our weekly enforcement-review procedure. Finance, I'll need your read on the reporting discrepancies. IP, please weigh in on the audit rights under our license agreement. Privacy, let me know if there are any concerns on your end. And account counsel, please give me the relationship perspective. Let's work through this systematically.

transcript.text: I need to share what my audit team has found. I personally reconciled Northstar's usage ledger against their royalty reports and confirmed an underpayment of exactly $284,600 for the third and fourth quarters of 2025. The reconciliation is still awaiting controller sign-off and has not yet been entered into the legal enforcement dashboard, so it wouldn't be visible to the rest of you yet. This is the quantified discrepancy behind the inconsistent usage figures we've been seeing.
